meta.title: Resource previews and URL compatibility
meta.description: Repairs `dsh-resource://` host parsing in older Chromium builds, then previews media, AVIF/TIFF/HEIC images, fonts, ZIP/TAR/GZ archives, and other binaries. Parsing runs in disposable Web Workers; media, image, and font decoding use the browser; files are never executed. Open a file from **Workspace files** and choose a viewer in the preview toolbar.
